title: Some of what I regularly see
content: I'm curious if anyone else has seen this in their world too. So obviously the shitty bathroom with multiple stalls and this us usually attached to a sports hall or indoor swimming pool at a school. I also sometimes see a big storage facility with huge indoor shutter doors between rooms that lead to a manufacturing factory. This is joined or near a gun storage unit. I regularly go to the beach with a wooden cabin looking bar (think SpongeBobs workplace but more modern), lots of glass window and there's normally a tsunami. This is attached to a holiday resort with modern rooms and giant full wall length windows. Inside one of the resort buildings is a beautiful ethereal man made waterfall, the ceiling is very high and it all has a dark blue but glowing tint. Up from this is a camping area with a couple of tents and if you go even further you'll reach a cliff with a narrow path you can walk on that leads to miles and miles of these giant mountains in the sea. Sometimes I fly around here in a plane. Going back to the resort, further towards the middle is a very tall building with a lift that's completely square and silver/metal. You can't see outside when in it and it regularly gets stuck or drops from the top all the way to the bottom or zooms up to the top. I also regularly see a joint airport, bus stop and university. The airport has very regular planes that you board straight from the road to the runway. The planes regularly crash or land on a motorway, or the runway is very short or contains a ramp. Inside the plane there is a secret door on the front right side that leads down into a sort of wet room mixed with a kids play area. Sometimes near the camping grounds there will be group bike rides that you can join and we always stop off at this huge indoor bus station before continuing down a huge countryside hill. The two most consistent things I see are a huge spiral staircase leading to multiple floors of the mall and a huge waterpark that is like a maze - you'll go down one slide and end up in a mini pool, then you choose another slide and so on. Little details that I can't quite explain properly: the sound of running on a floor that's hollow but topped with a felt material. Running from someone and hiding by going through a door, into a corridor, through another door, into another coridoor until I end up in a small room with 1 small window. It feels safe and the decoration is rustic and old. Lots of fabric, reds, greens, sound is muffled and I feel well hidden. A nature trail that always features animals that are dangerous in the fields to the left. Trees that are 100ft high.
